目标

核心问题 实现目标 量化指标（设计目标）
持久提交后需要后台排队 在已有 Session/Run 受理事务中增加 job，复用命令去重 同一主体、requestId、命令摘要对应 1 个 Run
Worker 退出或旧实例迟到回报 撤销执行权、清理资源，再从原 Checkpoint 接管 租约 15 秒；心跳 3 秒；受控夹具恢复目标 ≤21 秒
一个租户持续超额提交 公平选择有容量租户，隔离占用和积压 全局在途 2、每租户 1；未结束 Run 每租户 4、全局 12
同一会话刷新与续流 复用 Message 快照、Run 流和同一个 reducer Run 游标使用 Redis Stream ID；每 Run 自动折叠至多 1 次
双 Worker 调度与 Agent 执行边界 Worker 管理领取和续租，Agent 持有模型、工具和持久事务 单 Agent 执行所有者；两个 Worker 槽

时间指标适用于清理上界 2 秒、监督和轮询各 1 秒、往返与抖动预留共 2 秒的本机课堂夹具。未决外部效果继续保持待核对。

1. 方案概述

1.1 三条链共用持久运行底座

模块 职责 关键边界
分析 Chat / BFF 提交、加载完整消息、按游标订阅 沿用 sessions/submit、messages 和 runs/events；共享 AgentResponse v2
Agent Run API / Scheduler 同事务写入 job，检查配额，授予和撤销执行权 唯一业务 owner；一个 Agent 保持执行所有者锁
Worker claim、heartbeat、advance、release 独立服务凭据绑定 Worker 槽；不持有数据库或模型凭据
执行链 每次推进到可恢复边界，提交结果和 Checkpoint 每次实际派发、业务提交及流回调核对当前 epoch
Publisher / Projector Outbox 补发、Redis 短期流、SQL 完整投影 沿用持久化底座；终态与回答的完整投影提交后才公开

Worker 增加驱动与调度槽。模型、工具和工作流仍在 Agent 执行，Agent 计算容量沿用现有工具/模型并发控制。独立调度服务、任务 Broker 和专属进程池按后续实测决定。

1.2 接单、领取和逐边界推进

原子提交保存 Session/Run、消息、Outbox、命令回执和 job。收到 202 后可查询和订阅；断开订阅不影响后台调度。advance 立即返回运行中回执，重复同一命令轮询到下一持久边界。

2. 调度数据和执行权

2.1 只增加两张调度表

数据 唯一维护位置 用途
提交与控制幂等 既有 agent_command 复用作用域、requestId、摘要和回执
当前执行世代 既有 agent_run.execution_epoch grant 与 Attempt 引用同一值
积压、执行占用和 Worker 绑定 agent_run_job ready/leased/reclaiming/parked/done
公平排序 agent_tenant_schedule.last_claimed_at 选择最久未获调度的有容量租户
内部 advance 回执 agent_command 的 worker_advance kind 记录原 grant、运行中状态和已提交回执

job 的租户取自 Run 的 Session；外键仅在 Agent 本库内。leased/reclaiming 都占执行槽，同一 Worker 的这两种状态最多一条。parked 保留积压位置，完成清理后才释放执行槽。心跳只更新 expiry，不增加业务版本或流事件。

2.2 接管状态与清理

边界 规则
租约判断 取得行锁后读 clock_timestamp；过期心跳返回 lease_lost
锁序 调度锁（需要时）→ Session → Run → job → Step/Attempt → Wait/Action
公平领取 先选有容量租户，再选最早 ready job；争用 Session/Run 时继续其他候选
旧 Worker 回执 原凭据、boot、epoch 和摘要匹配时只读已提交回执；后继执行重新校验当前 grant
旧流回调 撤权后停止新输出；已确认包核对落盘，排空旧回调后才允许新 epoch
Agent 重启 保留单执行所有者约束；先补流和投影，再核对旧执行，最后开放调度

2.3 所有入口使用同一调度规则

submit、Resume、批准、外部等待条件满足和 v1 适配器都进入 job 队列；只有 claim 可授予 epoch。旧版无 job 的 Run 在首次显式恢复时检查积压容量，超限保持原状态可重试。已受理 parked 任务保留位置，有效决定后只改变其可调度状态。

3. 消息、事件和回答

场景 行为
刷新、打开历史 先加载 Message 完整快照，非终态 Run 从 projected_seq 续流
终态短期流到期 409 history_reload_required，重新加载 SQL 历史
活跃流丢失 410 stream_data_lost，保留投影并展示恢复受阻
Redis 暂不可用 流返回 503；SQL 历史继续可读，执行依照原持久化门禁暂停派发
权限过滤 当前范围校验覆盖快照、流和重连；安全占位保留 seq/revision，私有详情被移除；整对象不可最低展示时拒绝该 Run 读取
最终回答 同一成功边界的完整助手 message.upsert 与 completed run.upsert，投影提交后可见
失败与取消 incomplete 消息保留未完成标记，过程文字不触发答案切换

旁白采用确定性模板。调度 Timeline 也保存进完整投影，短期流过期后仍可查看；Worker/租约内部细节通过当前平台管理员身份读取；租户用量要求当前租户管理员。首期不启用模型旁白和新增分段回答。

用量与运行指标

项目 读取口径
租户用量 当前授权租户的限额、各 job 状态数量、积压、占用与预算汇总
排队时间 Run.created_at 到 job.first_claimed_at，按租户统计
槽位利用率 领取到确认释放的 Timeline 区间 / 观察窗×有效槽数；隔离占用单列
恢复成功率 成功接续数 / 需要接管数；受阻任务单列且包含在总数中
成本 已结算用量、未知保守占额和效果计数分别展示

1def accept(tx, owner, command, current_access):2    require_current_submit_access(current_access, owner)3    tx.lock_dispatch_admission()4    saved = tx.user_command(owner, command.request_id)5    if saved:6        return same_kind_and_input_or_conflict(saved, "submit", command)7    tx.require_backlog_capacity(owner.tenant_id)  # 包含parked和reclaiming。8    session = tx.lock_or_create_session(owner, command.session_id)9    tx.require_no_nonterminal_run(session)10    run = tx.create_m5_submission(session, owner, command)11    tx.insert_ready_job(run.id, tenant_id=owner.tenant_id)12    # Session/Run/消息/初始投影/Outbox/job/用户命令同事务提交。13    return tx.save_submit_receipt(owner, command, run)141516def claim(tx, worker):17    tx.require_agent_owner_and_streams_ready()18    tx.lock_dispatch_admission()19    existing = tx.job_for_worker_slot(worker.worker_id)20    if existing:21        session, run = tx.lock_session_then_run(existing.run_id)22        job = tx.lock_job(run.id)23        if job.worker_boot_id != worker.boot_id:24            return NoWork(reason="previous_process_cleanup")25        if job.status == "leased" and job.lease_expires_at > tx.clock_timestamp():26            return grant_from(run, job)  # claim响应丢失，返回原grant。27        return NoWork(reason="reclaim_pending")28    tx.require_global_execution_capacity()  # leased+reclaiming。29    for candidate in tx.fair_ready_candidates():30        # 按租户last_claimed_at、job.ready_at排序，争用候选不挡住后面的租户。31        locked = tx.try_lock_session_then_run(candidate, skip_locked=True)32        if locked is None:33            continue34        session, run = locked35        job = tx.lock_job(run.id)36        now = tx.clock_timestamp()  # 行锁取得后重新读取实际时钟。37        if not job.is_ready(now) or not tx.has_tenant_capacity(job.tenant_id):38            continue39        if not tx.recovery_and_projection_ready(run):40            continue41        run.execution_epoch = uuid4()42        tx.set_running(run)43        tx.lease(job, worker, expires_at=now + timedelta(seconds=15))44        tx.mark_first_claim_and_increment_count(job, now)45        tx.set_tenant_last_claimed(job.tenant_id, now)46        tx.record_scheduling_boundary(session, run, job, "claimed")47        return grant_from(run, job)48    return NoWork()

1def require_live_lease(run, job, worker, grant, now):2    require(worker.worker_id == grant.worker_id == job.worker_id, "lease_lost")3    require(worker.boot_id == grant.boot_id == job.worker_boot_id, "lease_lost")4    require(run.id == grant.run_id, "lease_lost")5    require(job.status == "leased", "lease_lost")6    require(run.execution_epoch == grant.epoch, "lease_lost")7    require(job.lease_expires_at > now, "lease_lost")8910def heartbeat(tx, worker, grant):11    session, run = tx.lock_session_then_run(grant.run_id)12    job = tx.lock_job(run.id)13    now = tx.clock_timestamp()14    require_live_lease(run, job, worker, grant, now)15    require(run.status == "running", "lease_lost")16    job.lease_expires_at = now + timedelta(seconds=15)17    return grant_from(run, job)181920async def advance(worker, command):21    await authz.recheck_run_execution(command.grant.run_id)22    with database.transaction() as tx:23        session, run = tx.lock_session_then_run(command.grant.run_id)24        job = tx.lock_job(run.id)25        key = internal_advance_key(command)26        saved = tx.worker_command(run.owner, key)27        if saved:28            require_same_worker_grant_and_digest(saved, worker, command)29            if saved.state == "committed":30                return saved.ack  # 已提交旧回执可重读；此分支无新写入。31        require_live_lease(run, job, worker, command.grant, tx.clock_timestamp())32        if saved:33            require(saved.state == "running", "command_interrupted")34            return saved.ack  # 暂停意图不妨碍只读轮询正在收口的原命令。35        require(run.status == "running" and run.control_intent is None, "run_not_runnable")36        require((run.checkpoint_no or 0) == command.expected_checkpoint, "checkpoint_conflict")37        saved = tx.prepare_worker_command(run, worker, command, key)38    # 任务map按Run/command去重；任务归lifespan，HTTP结束不取消。39    # 受理提交后尚未启动即崩溃，旧命令由启动回收处理，保持可诊断。40    try:41        tasks.ensure_boundary_task(saved.id, lambda: execute_one_boundary(worker, command))42    except TaskStartError:43        await scheduler.reclaim_unstarted_command(saved.id)44        return interrupted_ack(saved, "execution_start_failed")45    return saved.ack464748def commit_advance(tx, worker, command, outcome):49    session, run = tx.lock_session_then_run(command.grant.run_id)50    job = tx.lock_job(run.id)51    saved = tx.worker_command(run.owner, internal_advance_key(command))52    require_same_worker_grant_and_digest(saved, worker, command)53    if saved.state == "committed":54        return saved.ack55    require_live_lease(run, job, worker, command.grant, tx.clock_timestamp())56    require(run.status == "running", "run_not_runnable")57    require((run.checkpoint_no or 0) == command.expected_checkpoint, "checkpoint_conflict")58    result = tx.commit_m5_boundary(session, run, outcome)59    # Outcome由Agent执行器产生，Worker不能上传模型输出、成本或业务结果。60    if result.resources_confirmed and result.waiting_or_paused:61        tx.park_and_clear_epoch(run, job)62    elif result.resources_confirmed and result.terminal:63        tx.finish_job_and_clear_epoch(run, job)64    elif result.resources_unconfirmed:65        tx.revoke_and_reclaim(run, job, reason="cleanup_unconfirmed")66    if result.scheduling_changed:67        # 扩充本事务刚创建、尚未发布的同一Outbox，保留一个run_version。68        tx.append_scheduling_to_boundary(result.outbox_id, run, job)69    return tx.commit_worker_ack(saved, result)

1def resume_or_approve(tx, owner, command, current_access):2    # 可能为旧M5 Run补job，从事务起点取调度锁。3    tx.lock_dispatch_admission()4    session, run = tx.lock_session_then_run(command.run_id)5    job = tx.lock_job_if_present(run.id)6    previous = tx.user_command(owner, command.request_id)7    if previous:8        return same_kind_and_input_or_conflict(previous, command.kind, command)9    tx.validate_m5_control(session, run, command, current_access)10    tx.require_parked_or_legacy_job_for_new_resume(job, command)11    if job is None:12        tx.require_backlog_capacity(session.tenant_id)13        job = tx.insert_parked_job(run.id, session.tenant_id)14    ack = tx.apply_m5_decision_without_starting_executor(session, run, command)15    if ack.can_resume:16        tx.require_current_resources_settled(run)17        tx.clear_satisfied_control_intent(run)18        run.reason_code = "queued"19        tx.make_ready(job)  # 保留waiting/paused，claim时才转running和授予epoch。20    elif ack.terminal:21        tx.finish_job_and_clear_epoch(run, job)22    tx.record_control_outbox(session, run, ack)23    return tx.save_user_command_receipt(owner, command, ack)242526async def reclaim(run_id):27    with database.transaction() as tx:28        session, run = tx.lock_session_then_run(run_id)29        job = tx.lock_job(run_id)30        now = tx.clock_timestamp()31        if job.status == "leased" and job.lease_expires_at <= now:32            tx.revoke_and_reclaim(run, job, reason="lease_expired")33        if job.status != "reclaiming":34            return35    # 撤权先提交；执行句柄、旧流回调与效果核对在锁外完成。36    receipt = await execution.stop_and_reconcile_original_attempts(run_id)37    with database.transaction() as tx:38        session, run = tx.lock_session_then_run(run_id)39        job = tx.lock_job(run_id)40        require(job.status == "reclaiming", "recovery_conflict")41        tx.record_cleanup_receipt(run, receipt)42        if not receipt.resources_confirmed:43            tx.mark_recovery_blocked(run, receipt.reason)  # 仍占槽。44        elif run.status == "cancelling":45            tx.finish_canceled_if_effects_reconciled(run, job, receipt)46        elif run.control_intent == "pause" or tx.has_pending_wait(run):47            tx.park_and_clear_epoch(run, job)48        elif tx.safe_checkpoint_and_effects_confirmed(run, receipt):49            tx.interrupt_unfinished_worker_commands(run)50            tx.make_ready_and_clear_lease(job)51        else:52            tx.park_recovery_blocked(run, job, receipt.reason)53        tx.record_recovery_outbox(session, run, job)

1def scheduling_view(run, job, transition_id, reason, occurred_at):2    return ViewUpsert(3        object_id=f"timeline:{transition_id}", revision=1, kind="timeline",4        value=PublicTimelineEntry(5            run_id=run.id, phase="scheduling", status=job.status,6            reason_code=public_reason(reason), claim_count=job.claim_count,7            occurred_at=occurred_at,8        ),9    )101112def filter_public_response(body, access):13    require_owned_session_and_runs(body, access)14    packets = []15    for packet in body.packets:16        # snapshot/delta调用同一函数，保留身份、seq和revision。17        if packet.event.type == "view.upsert":18            event = allowlisted_view_or_safe_placeholder(packet.event, access)19        else:20            event = require_visible_message_or_run(packet.event, access)21        packets.append(packet.with_event(event))22    return body.with_packets(packets)

1function applyScheduledResponse(state: SessionView, response: unknown): SessionView {2  const next = applyAgentResponse(state, response); // M5：整帧校验与原子应用。3  for (const run of next.runs) {4    const answer = next.completedAssistantMessage(run.id);5    const completed = run.status === "completed" && answer !== undefined;6    if (completed && !next.answerTransitionSeen.has(run.id)) {7      next.answerTransitionSeen.add(run.id);8      // 用户显式展开优先，重复快照与旧事件不改变这一选择。9      if (!next.userProcessPreference.has(run.id)) next.collapseProcess(run.id);10    }11  }12  return next;13}
